page_title: GET 0-1 RMA | Getafe v Real Madrid 23/04/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.

90+7' Alvaro Rodriguez (Getafe) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a low shot in the direction of the left post. Thibaut Courtois is alert and denies him with a nice save.
90+6' Rodrygo (Real Madrid) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.
90+5' Peter Federico (Getafe) makes it easy for the referee to show him a yellow card.
90+3' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Getafe comes to nothing.
90+1' Alvaro Rodriguez (Getafe) is shown a yellow card by the referee for making a challenge on his opponent, but he looks angry with the decision.

90+1' Half-chance! Coba da Costa (Getafe) plays a pass into the box, but Thibaut Courtois reacts well to snuff out the attack. Juanmi (Getafe) picks up the rebound and shoots. The goalkeeper was ready and denies his effort with a fine save.
90+1' There will be a minimum of 6 min. of added time.
88' Eduardo Camavinga (Real Madrid) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
87' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Luis Milla (Getafe) was quite harsh and Jose Sanchez didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
86' Alvaro Rodriguez (Getafe) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Jose Sanchez has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle. Real Madrid earn a free kick.

84' Mauro Arambarri (Getafe) put a cross into the box which wasn't a bad decision, but he failed to achieve what he wanted as none of his teammates managed to meet it. The ball goes out of play and Real Madrid will have a goal kick.
84' The free kick from long range, taken by Getafe, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
83' Jose Bordalas Jimenez decides to make a substitution. Djene will be replaced by Ismael Bekhoucha (Getafe).
83' Substitution. Borja Mayoral makes his way off the pitch and Juanmi (Getafe) comes on as his replacement.
83' Jose Sanchez couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Dani Ceballos (Real Madrid) and blew his whistle. Getafe have been awarded a free kick.
80' The fouls committed statistics – 10:6.
78' Carlo Ancelotti prepares a substitution. Arda Guler is replaced by Dani Ceballos (Real Madrid).
77' Lucas Vazquez (Real Madrid) did his best to latch onto a through ball, but it was too strong. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Getafe.
75' The attendance is 15184.
73' Rodrygo (Real Madrid) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Vinicius Junior.
73' Mauro Arambarri (Getafe) does well inside the box to bring down a pass from Borja Mayoral. He gets away a decent shot but it creeps just past the right post.
71' The defensive wall does its job and blocks the mid-range attempt from the free-kick by Peter Federico (Getafe).
70' Getafe are awarded a free kick from mid-range. The position is unsuitable for a direct shot, so expect a cross into the box.
69' Aurelien Tchouameni (Real Madrid) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Jose Sanchez had an easy-decision to make.
69' Substitution. Ramon Terrats leaves the pitch and is replaced by Peter Federico (Getafe).
68' The resulting set piece from Real Madrid is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
68' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid) heads on.

67' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) dribbles his way to the edge of the box and drills a shot towards the top of the net, but David Soria is equal to the effort and makes a good save. Real Madrid force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
66' The current number of shots on goal is 2:6.
64' Here's the change. Endrick leaves the pitch and Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid) comes on as a substitute.
63' Coba da Costa (Getafe) volleys the ball towards goal from the edge of the penalty box, but one of the defenders blocks his shot.
61' Brahim Diaz (Real Madrid) connected with a pass around the edge of the box, aimed and shot. His attempt went towards the left-hand post, but David Soria was alert and the score remains the same.
59' Jose Sanchez blows the whistle, Juan Bernat (Getafe) is penalised for a foul. It's a free kick to Real Madrid, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.
58' Luis Milla (Getafe) expertly controls the pass inside the penalty area and shoots, but it's inadvertently blocked a defender.
58' Coba da Costa pings in a cross towards the edge of the six-yard box. Alvaro Rodriguez (Getafe) jumps highest but sends his header just over the bar.

57' Endrick (Real Madrid) receives a low pass just outside the box and unleashes a fine strike towards the middle of the goal. David Soria pulls off a reflexive save to block his effort. Nice goalkeeping skill, indeed.
56' One of the players from Getafe times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
56' Borja Mayoral (Getafe) is first to the rebound but his shot is blocked. Wow, what an escape there for the opposition.
56' A lofted cross from Coba da Costa (Getafe) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
53' The corner is swung in but Getafe can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

53' Good clearance! Borja Mayoral (Getafe) received a low pass, but he didn't have time to do anything as one of the defenders quickly stole the ball off him. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Getafe.
50' Jose Bordalas Jimenez has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Alvaro Rodriguez (Getafe) replacing Juan Antonio Iglesias Sanchez.
50' Juan Berrocal Gonzalez goes off the pitch and Coba da Costa (Getafe) comes on.
50' Referee Jose Sanchez sees the trip by Endrick (Real Madrid) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle. Getafe have a free kick.
49' Arda Guler (Real Madrid) whips in the resulting set piece but it's cleared.
48' Domingos Duarte (Getafe) commits an ugly challenge. The referee sees it and immediately blows his whistle. There is a free kick near the sideline to Real Madrid.
47' Mauro Arambarri (Getafe) picks up a pass and tries his luck from mid-range towards the bottom left corner, but Thibaut Courtois is equal to it and makes an easy save.
46' Half-time substitution. David Alaba will not participate anymore and Eduardo Camavinga (Real Madrid) is coming on.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+3' The match has reached half-time.
45+1' Djene (Getafe) was too forceful with his tackle and Jose Sanchez interrupted the game to signal a free kick. Real Madrid are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
45' 2 additional min. will be played.
45' Getafe couldn't find the way to score from a long-range free kick as Thibaut Courtois (Real Madrid) leaped high and intercepted a cross.
44' A player from Real Madrid commits a rough challenge. Jose Sanchez blows for a foul and keeps the game under control. Getafe are awarded a free kick.
42' Neat passing move from Real Madrid in order to create new attacking opportunities.

38' Brahim Diaz (Real Madrid) connected with a pass around the edge of the box, aimed and shot. His attempt went towards the top right corner, but David Soria was alert and the score remains the same.

35' The defence had a hard time blocking out the strike from Federico Valverde (Real Madrid). He didn't hesitate and finished from outside the box right after he had received a pass from his teammate.
33' None of the Real Madrid players could reach the corner kick as the ball was overhit and goes out of play.
31' Juan Bernat (Getafe) is penalised after knocking an opponent down. Real Madrid have a free kick.

29' Arda Guler (Real Madrid) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Jose Sanchez no option but to blow his whistle. Getafe are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
26' The Real Madrid players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
21' 0 - 1 Goal! Arda Guler (Real Madrid) picks up the ball from a rebound and from the edge of the box he unleashes a shot inside the left post. It's 0:1.
21' Fran Garcia (Real Madrid) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.

21' Brahim Diaz (Real Madrid) collects a great pass inside the box and misses a golden opportunity. His low drive is headed for the bottom left corner, but the goalkeeper pulls off a marvellous diving save and denies him.
21' Getafe quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
20' Juan Antonio Iglesias Sanchez (Getafe) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. Now Getafe have a corner.
18' Fran Garcia (Real Madrid) latches onto a rebound in the box and fires a shot a whisker wide of the right post. That was a promising chance and maybe he should have done better!
18' David Soria was forced into action to thwart Fran Garcia (Real Madrid). He found himself some space after picking up a pass and unleashed a shot to the left post but couldn't beat the keeper.
16' Borja Mayoral (Getafe) latched on to a lofted pass inside the box, but his header misses to the right of the target.
15' Getafe can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
15' Borja Mayoral (Getafe) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. Getafe force a corner. They send men into the box.
14' Arda Guler (Real Madrid) overhits the corner kick and none of his teammates can their head on it.
14' Arda Guler (Real Madrid) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
13' The ball is cleared after Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The referee points to the corner flag and Real Madrid will take a corner.
12' Wasted opportunity! Ramon Terrats (Getafe) picked up a pass and had lots of options, but instead decided to shoot from distance and it went high over the bar.
9' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.

6' Arda Guler sprays a wonderful pass out to Federico Valverde (Real Madrid), who cannot get enough power or direction to cause David Soria problems and the goalkeeper is able to watch the ball go just wide of the left post.
4' Domingos Duarte (Getafe) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
3' Looks like Djene (Getafe) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
2' Luis Milla (Getafe) collects a pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a low drive to the middle, but Thibaut Courtois makes a save.
1' Domingos Duarte (Getafe) commits a rough challenge and Jose Sanchez blows his whistle for a foul. Real Madrid will take a free kick near the side line.
